<?php
/**
 * Distributed Cache Client with async upload processing
 * Handles user-uploaded serialized cache entries across nodes
 */

declare(ticks=1);

class CacheNodeConnection {
    private string $host;
    private int $port;
    private $socket;
    private bool $connected = false;
    
    public function __construct(string $host, int $port) {
        $this->host = $host;
        $this->port = $port;
    }
    
    public function connect(): bool {
        $this->socket = @fsockopen($this->host, $this->port, $errno, $errstr, 5);
        $this->connected = ($this->socket !== false);
        return $this->connected;
    }
    
    public function isConnected(): bool {
        return $this->connected;
    }
    
    public function disconnect(): void {
        if ($this->socket) {
            fclose($this->socket);
            $this->connected = false;
        }
    }
}

class UploadProcessor {
    private string $uploadDir;
    private string $processingDir;
    private array $pendingFiles = [];
    private bool $shuttingDown = false;
    private ?string $currentFile = null;
    private $lockHandle = null;
    private bool $inCriticalSection = false;
    
    public function __construct(string $uploadDir, string $processingDir) {
        $this->uploadDir = rtrim($uploadDir, '/');
        $this->processingDir = rtrim($processingDir, '/');
        $this->setupSignalHandlers();
    }
    
    private function setupSignalHandlers(): void {
        pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
        pcntl_signal(SIGINT, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
        pcntl_signal(SIGUSR1, [$this, 'handleReloadSignal']);
    }
    
    public function handleSignal(int $signo): void {
        $this->shuttingDown = true;
        // Do NOT call cleanup from signal context - defer to main loop
    }
    
    public function handleReloadSignal(int $signo): void {
        // Set flag only - actual reload happens in main loop
        $this->shuttingDown = false;
    }
    
    private function cleanupCurrentOperation(): void {
        if ($this->currentFile !== null) {
            // Move file back to upload dir if we were mid-processing
            $basename = basename($this->currentFile);
            $dest = $this->uploadDir . '/' . $basename;
            if (file_exists($this->currentFile)) {
                rename($this->currentFile, $dest);
            }
            $this->currentFile = null;
        }
        $this->releaseLock();
    }
    
    private function acquireLock(string $file): bool {
        $lockFile = $file . '.lock';
        $this->lockHandle = fopen($lockFile, 'w');
        if ($this->lockHandle === false) return false;
        return flock($this->lockHandle, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB);
    }
    
    private function releaseLock(): void {
        if ($this->lockHandle) {
            flock($this->lockHandle, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($this->lockHandle);
            $this->lockHandle = null;
        }
    }
    
    public function scanUploadDirectory(): array {
        $files = glob($this->uploadDir . '/*.cache');
        return $files ?: [];
    }
    
    public function processUploads(CacheDistributor $distributor): void {
        $this->pendingFiles = $this->scanUploadDirectory();
        
        foreach ($this->pendingFiles as $file) {
            if ($this->shuttingDown) {
                $this->cleanupCurrentOperation();
                break;
            }
            $this->processFile($file, $distributor);
        }
    }
    
    private function processFile(string $file, CacheDistributor $distributor): void {
        $basename = basename($file);
        
        // Validate filename format: alphanumeric with .cache extension
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.cache$/', $basename)) {
            error_log("Invalid filename rejected: $basename");
            return;
        }
        
        $processingPath = $this->processingDir . '/' . $basename;
        
        if (!$this->acquireLock($file)) {
            return; // Another worker has it
        }
        
        // Atomically move to processing directory
        if (!rename($file, $processingPath)) {
            $this->releaseLock();
            return;
        }
        
        $this->currentFile = $processingPath;
        
        // Read and validate the cache entry
        $content = file_get_contents($processingPath);
        if ($content === false || strlen($content) > 1048576) {
            $this->rejectFile($processingPath);
            return;
        }
        
        $entry = $this->deserializeCacheEntry($content);
        if ($entry === null) {
            $this->rejectFile($processingPath);
            return;
        }
        
        // Distribute to cache nodes
        $distributor->distribute($entry);
        
        // Cleanup
        unlink($processingPath);
        $this->currentFile = null;
        $this->releaseLock();
    }
    
    private function deserializeCacheEntry(string $content): ?array {
        // Parse our custom binary format
        // Header: 4 bytes magic, 4 bytes key_len, 4 bytes val_len, 4 bytes ttl
        if (strlen($content) < 16) return null;
        
        $header = unpack('Nmagic/Nkey_len/Nval_len/Nttl', $content);
        if ($header['magic'] !== 0xCAC4E000) return null;
        
        $keyLen = $header['key_len'];
        $valLen = $header['val_len'];
        $ttl = $header['ttl'];
        
        if ($keyLen > 256 || $valLen > 1048000) return null;
        if (strlen($content) < 16 + $keyLen + $valLen) return null;
        
        $key = substr($content, 16, $keyLen);
        $value = substr($content, 16 + $keyLen, $valLen);
        
        // Validate key is printable ASCII
        if (!ctype_print($key)) return null;
        
        return [
            'key' => $key,
            'value' => $value,
            'ttl' => min($ttl, 86400)
        ];
    }
    
    private function rejectFile(string $path): void {
        unlink($path);
        $this->currentFile = null;
        $this->releaseLock();
    }
}

class CacheDistributor {
    private array $nodes = [];
    private string $hashAlgo = 'xxh3';
    
    public function addNode(CacheNodeConnection $node): void {
        $this->nodes[] = $node;
    }
    
    public function distribute(array $entry): bool {
        if (empty($this->nodes)) return false;
        
        $nodeIndex = crc32($entry['key']) % count($this->nodes);
        $node = $this->nodes[$nodeIndex];
        
        if (!$node->isConnected()) {
            $node->connect();
        }
        
        return $node->isConnected();
    }
}

// Main execution
function main(): void {
    $uploadDir = getenv('CACHE_UPLOAD_DIR') ?: '/var/spool/cache/uploads';
    $processingDir = getenv('CACHE_PROCESSING_DIR') ?: '/var/spool/cache/processing';
    
    // Ensure directories exist with proper permissions
    if (!is_dir($uploadDir) || !is_dir($processingDir)) {
        die("Required directories do not exist\n");
    }
    
    $distributor = new CacheDistributor();
    $distributor->addNode(new CacheNodeConnection('cache1.internal', 11211));
    $distributor->addNode(new CacheNodeConnection('cache2.internal', 11211));
    
    $processor = new UploadProcessor($uploadDir, $processingDir);
    
    while (true) {
        $processor->processUploads($distributor);
        usleep(500000); // 500ms polling interval
    }
}

main();
